claims.claim: Israeli non-geographic nationwide numbers use the 07 area code (071-079), allocated to landline and VoIP operators, in +972 international format.
claims.raw_snippet: Non-geographic nationwide area code can be used by Landline and VoIP operators.

claims.claim: Israel implemented number portability on 2007-12-03 (landline and mobile), so a mobile prefix indicates the originally issuing carrier rather than the currently servicing one.
claims.raw_snippet: Israel 2007.12.03 up-to 30 minutes Free Service includes landline as well as mobile numbers
claims.verification_note: The Telephone_numbers_in_Israel article states the portability consequence but gives no date: "Due to mobile number portability, a mobile phone with a prefix of one provider can be associated with a different provider." The 2007 date comes from the Mobile_number_portability country table.

claims.claim: 059 is allocated to Jawwal and 056 to Ooredoo Palestine (formerly Wataniya); both are Palestinian-territories-only carriers whose numbers match the Israeli mobile shape.
claims.raw_snippet: 056 XXX-XXXX +972 56 XXX-XXXX Ooredoo Palestine Palestinian territories only 058 XXX-XXXX +972 58 XXX-XXXX Golan Telecom 059 XXX-XXXX +972 59 XXX-XXXX Jawwal Palestinian territories only
claims.verification_note: CORRECTION to the evidence text: the article names 056 as Ooredoo Palestine, not Wataniya (Wataniya Mobile rebranded to Ooredoo Palestine). SKILL.md already said "Ooredoo Palestine, formerly Wataniya", so no body change was needed.

claims.claim: Israel's Ministry of Communications publishes official numbering-plan changes at gov.il under /departments/ministry_of_communications.
Israel's Ministry of Communications also publishes the Hebrew version of its homepage at gov.il/he/departments/ministry_of_communications.
Google's libphonenumber is the common Java, C++ and JavaScript library for parsing, formatting and validating international phone numbers.
claims.raw_snippet:
Google's common Java, C++ and JavaScript library for parsing, formatting, and
validating international phone numbers.

claims.claim: The libphonenumber-js npm package is a JavaScript port of Google's libphonenumber commonly used in frontend phone-input components.
Israeli numbers are written (0A) XXX-XXXX for landline and 05N-XXX-XXXX for mobile domestically, and with the +972 country code internationally (the leading 0 is dropped).
Israeli emergency short codes: 100 Police, 101 Magen David Adom (ambulance), 102 Fire Fighters.
claims.raw_snippet: 100 : Police 101 : Magen David Adom : Ambulance Service and Emergency Medical Response 102 : Fire Fighters

claims.claim: Israel operates shortened business "star numbers", listed by the Ministry of Communications. *2421 appears in this skill only as an illustrative example of the *XXXX shape, with no claim about which business operates it.
claims.raw_snippet: Shortened business numbers (star numbers) at the Israel Ministry of Communications (in Hebrew)
claims.verification_note: The Wikipedia article links the MoC star-number registry under External links but does not enumerate specific star codes, so no specific star code is asserted by this skill.
